heating.sql: SELECT s.StoreyName AS Storey, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.Category = 'IFCPIPESEGMENT') AS PipeSegments, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.Category = 'IFCPIPEFITTING') AS PipeFittings, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.Category = 'IFCSPACEHEATER') AS SpaceHeaters, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.Category = 'IFCVALVE') AS Valves, count(*) AS AllElements FROM EntityText e JOIN StoreyOfElement s ON s.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex GROUP BY s.StoreyName ORDER BY s.StoreyName
